description: Variation to part of the wording of conditions 2 and 3 of planning permission ref: 2025/03474/FUL granted 11th February 2026 for the 'Replacement of all existing single glazed timber framed windows and existing double glazed uPVC framed windows with new double glazed uPVC framed windows; replacement of all front entrance doors with new 44mm Guardian GT30 Security FD30S single leaf doorset' to change from  'Front and Rear Elevation Window composite panels: Double glazed Total 70R in RAL white' to 'Front and Rear Elevation Window composite panels: Double glazed Total 70R in RAL 7016'.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission, Ref. 2025/03474/FUL granted 11th February 2026.

Condition required to be imposed by Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
